blocks.text: Good sex shouldn’t come with a high price tag. That’s why PREMIERE Condoms is permanently lowering its prices across all variants to only Php55. As a social enterprise, DKT Health, Inc. believes that everyone deserves access to quality protection, especially as the cost of living continues to rise. While prices elsewhere are going up, PREMIERE Condoms is moving in the opposite direction, making protection more affordable rather than less. The rollback comes at a critical moment for public health in the Philippines. The Department of Health recorded 4,633 new HIV cases in the first quarter of 2026 alone, an average of […]...
